conversationListInitial.query: select "session_row"."id" as "sessionId", "session_row"."title" as "title", "session_row"."project_id" as "projectId", "session_row"."workspace_id" as "workspaceId", "session_row"."development_environment_id" as "developmentEnvironmentId", "session_row"."state" as "state", "session_row"."execution_mode" as "executionMode", "session_row"."sandbox_profile_key" as "sandboxProfileKey", "session_row"."working_directory" as "workingDirectory", "session_row"."created_at" as "createdAt", "session_row"."updated_at" as "updatedAt", "session_row"."last_active_at" as "lastActiveAt", "session_row"."conversation_parent_session_id" as "parentSessionId", "project"."name" as "workspaceName", "workspace"."deleted_at" as "workspaceDeletedAt", count("turn"."id") as "turnCount", to_char(session_row.last_active_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as "cursorAt" from "sessions" as "session_row" inner join "projects" as "project" on "project"."tenant_id" = "session_row"."tenant_id" and "project"."id" = "session_row"."project_id" inner join "workspaces" as "workspace" on "workspace"."tenant_id" = "session_row"."tenant_id" and "workspace"."id" = "session_row"."workspace_id" left join "turns" as "turn" on "turn"."tenant_id" = "session_row"."tenant_id" and "turn"."session_id" = "session_row"."id" and "turn"."pruned_at" is null and "turn"."state" != $1 and not (turn.state='cancelled' and turn.started_at is null) where "session_row"."tenant_id" = $2 and "session_row"."session_kind" = $3 and "session_row"."pruned_at" is null group by "session_row"."id", "session_row"."title", "session_row"."project_id", "session_row"."workspace_id", "session_row"."development_environment_id", "session_row"."state", "session_row"."execution_mode", "session_row"."sandbox_profile_key", "session_row"."working_directory", "session_row"."created_at", "session_row"."updated_at", "session_row"."last_active_at", "session_row"."conversation_parent_session_id", "project"."name", "workspace"."deleted_at" order by "session_row"."last_active_at" desc, "session_row"."id" desc limit $4
conversationListInitial.candidateQuery: select "session_row"."id" as "sessionId", "session_row"."title" as "title", "session_row"."project_id" as "projectId", "session_row"."workspace_id" as "workspaceId", "session_row"."development_environment_id" as "developmentEnvironmentId", "session_row"."state" as "state", "session_row"."execution_mode" as "executionMode", "session_row"."sandbox_profile_key" as "sandboxProfileKey", "session_row"."working_directory" as "workingDirectory", "session_row"."created_at" as "createdAt", "session_row"."updated_at" as "updatedAt", "session_row"."last_active_at" as "lastActiveAt", "session_row"."conversation_parent_session_id" as "parentSessionId", "project"."name" as "workspaceName", "workspace"."deleted_at" as "workspaceDeletedAt", counts."turnCount", to_char(session_row.last_active_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as "cursorAt" from (select * from sessions where tenant_id=$2 and session_kind=$3 and pruned_at is null order by last_active_at desc,id desc limit $4) as "session_row" inner join "projects" as "project" on "project"."tenant_id" = "session_row"."tenant_id" and "project"."id" = "session_row"."project_id" inner join "workspaces" as "workspace" on "workspace"."tenant_id" = "session_row"."tenant_id" and "workspace"."id" = "session_row"."workspace_id" left join lateral (select count(*)::text as "turnCount" from turns t where t.tenant_id=session_row.tenant_id and t.session_id=session_row.id and t.pruned_at is null and t.state<>$1 and not(t.state='cancelled' and t.started_at is null)) counts on true where "session_row"."tenant_id" = $2 and "session_row"."session_kind" = $3 and "session_row"."pruned_at" is null order by "session_row"."last_active_at" desc, "session_row"."id" desc limit $4

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sessions_pkey ON bench.sessions USING btree (id)

CREATE INDEX sessions_tenant_id_conversation_parent_session_id_created_a_idx ON bench.sessions USING btree (tenant_id, conversation_parent_session_id, created_at) WHERE (conversation_parent_session_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sessions_tenant_id_id_key ON bench.sessions USING btree (tenant_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX turns_pkey ON bench.turns USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX turns_session_id_created_at_id_idx ON bench.turns USING btree (session_id, created_at, id) WHERE (state = 'queued'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX turns_session_id_id_key ON bench.turns USING btree (session_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX turns_session_id_idx ON bench.turns USING btree (session_id) WHERE (state = ANY (ARRAY['dispatching'::text, 'running'::text, 'waiting_approval'::text, 'cancelling'::text]))
CREATE INDEX turns_tenant_id_idx ON bench.turns USING btree (tenant_id) WHERE (state = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'dispatching'::text, 'running'::text, 'waiting_approval'::text, 'cancelling'::text]))
CREATE INDEX turns_tenant_id_session_id_created_at_idx ON bench.turns USING btree (tenant_id, session_id, created_at) WHERE (pruned_at IS NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX turns_tenant_id_session_id_id_key ON bench.turns USING btree (tenant_id, session_id, id)

Plans.Filter: ((pruned_at IS NULL) AND (state <> 'queued'::text) AND ((state <> 'cancelled'::text) OR (started_at IS NOT NULL)) AND (tenant_id = 'c6681c24-5bbe-4ccf-8466-168dae84ca29'::uuid))
